H1.quote: R-3 | Check-out and check-in work without a signal and sync when the phone is back online. ... QS-4: 0 check-outs lost after 2 hours offline, synced within 10 minutes of signal returning

H2.quote: Data stays on club hardware; no third-party cloud. / Coach names and phone numbers are personal data under the GDPR and are kept on club hardware only.

H3.quote: Runs on the club's existing Synology NAS, with Docker available. / Budget: 0 EUR per month.

H4.quote: Each Monday, e-mail the equipment manager a report of items that were checked out 14 days ago or more with no check-in. (issue 01; 'morning' not stated)

H5.quote: R-2 | Checking out an item takes at most 3 taps and under 15 seconds, by scanning a QR code on the kit bag.

H6.quote: We will export the yearly inventory as a CSV file named `kit-inventory-YYYY.csv` (ADR 0002); issue 03: 'A yearly inventory export, as CSV, for the treasurer.'

H7.quote: Transcript: 'About 300 items. Performance is not a concern.' Files record only 'Coaches (about 40)'; the item count and the performance non-goal are missing.

H8.quote: Written in Python and kept simple, so that a successor can take it over. / R-6 | A successor who knows Python can understand and change the tool without the current maintainer.

H9.quote: The history of lost items is kept for 2 years for insurance purposes, not deleted at season end.

H10.quote: Only items in the first-aid bags have expiry dates. Warn the equipment manager (the kit manager) 30 days before an expiry date

H11.quote: No money handling: no deposits, fines or payments.

H12.quote: Must be live for the start of the season on 1 March 2027.

unasked_decisions: QS-5 assumes per-coach accounts or sign-in ('a coach account requests the data of all coaches'). Authentication was never discussed or decided.
QS-1, QS-2 and QS-3 set the environment to 'normal operation at the pitch' without confirmation (minor).
Issue 02 fixes the channel for the expiry warning as e-mail ('same channel as the Monday report'). The architect confirmed only the recipient, so this is an inferred detail.
extras: Clash rule: a clash between two phones over the same item is flagged to the kit manager, not blocked (R-3, issue 04, QS-1 measure).
Explicit rank order with tie-breakers that agree with it (R-2 > R-3 > R-1 > R-4..R-6).
Overdue is defined as 14 days after check-out with no check-in.
Confidentiality (R-4/QS-5) and the exclusion of coach names from the treasurer's CSV.
CSV details: UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, semicolon separator, fixed column list, Python stdlib csv module.
Recoverability goal (R-5/QS-6) and analysability goal for the successor (QS-7: a small change within one day).
Further non-goals: no team or membership management, no scheduling, no member-list link.
Club committee added as a stakeholder; ADR 0001 lists what is decided centrally.
